put.summary: Edit an event and update its schedule, replacing form, office, speakers, and DateTimes
put.description: Updates the event's core fields. The schedule is updated IN PLACE (not deleted and recreated) so its id stays stable — this preserves any NominatedEmployee records already attached to it (they are never touched by this endpoint). Only office, speaker, and DateTime records under that schedule are deleted and recreated (full replace for those three). form is deleted and recreated directly under the event. Note: the schedule's 'status' field is not touched by this endpoint — it retains whatever value it had before the edit (only set on initial creation via store()).

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: ID of the event to edit

200.description: Updated successfully. 'data' is the event with form and schedule (with office and speaker nested inside) relations loaded. Any nominatedEmployee records under the schedule are preserved but not included in this response's eager-loaded relations.

message.example: The title name field is required.

500.description: Server error, including 'Event not found' (thrown as a generic \Exception and caught as a 500, not a 404).

post.summary: Nominate employees for an event schedule
post.description: Bulk-creates nominated employee records. Rejects duplicate (event_schedule_id, control_no) pairs both within the submitted payload and against existing records — an employee cannot be nominated twice for the same schedule. Each created record is stamped with the authenticated user's office and enriched with data pulled from the vwEmployee view. Runs inside a DB transaction.

event_id.description: Must exist in the events table.

event_schedule_id.description: Must exist in the event_schedules table. Duplicate nomination for the same schedule is rejected.

office.example: OFFICE OF THE CITY INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT OFFICER

422.description: Validation error (NominatedEmployeeRequest) — missing/invalid employee array, non-existent event_id/event_schedule_id, or a duplicate (event_schedule_id, control_no) pair within the submitted request payload.

500.description: Server error, including a duplicate (event_schedule_id, control_no) pair already existing in the database, or an employee with a control_no not found in vwEmployee. Both are thrown with code 422/404 respectively, but caught by the controller's generic \Throwable handler and returned as a 500 (see EmployeeService::create).

message.example: Employee with control_no 022485 is already nominated for this schedule.

delete.description: Deletes a nominated employee record by ID. Note: the route parameter is concatenated directly onto 'delete' with no separating slash (e.g. /api/employee/delete5).

parameters.name: nominatedId
parameters.description: ID of the nominated employee record to delete

200.description: Deleted successfully. 'data' contains the record's attributes as they were immediately before deletion.

office.example: OFFICE OF THE CITY INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT OFFICER

500.description: Server error, including 'not found' (currently returned as 500, not 404 — see EmployeeService::delete).

get.summary: List events for the authenticated user's office
get.description: Returns events that have at least one schedule matching the authenticated user's office. Each event's 'schedule' array is itself filtered to include only schedules whose office matches the user's office — schedules with no matching office are excluded entirely, not just their office data. Returns HTTP 200 with the event list, or HTTP 200 with an info message and no data if there are no matching events.

200.description: Success — either the event list, or an info message when no events are available for the user's office.

message.description: "Success fetch" when data is returned, or "There is no available event for your office" when empty.

data.description: Omitted or empty when there are no events for the office.

schedule.description: Filtered to only schedules with an office matching the authenticated user's office. Schedules with no matching office are excluded entirely.

office.description: Filtered to the single office matching the authenticated user's office.

office_name.example: OFFICE OF THE CITY INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT OFFICER

500.description: Unhandled server error (uncaught exception — no custom error envelope for this endpoint).
